title: VIRTUAL SINGER Chapter1 Episode13 An Adult's Palate

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Humhumhuuum♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Len, you sure have been in a good mood lately.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, can you tell? I'm still excited after meeting Kohane and An the other day. They were really nice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That explains why you're so happy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I am too.
I think those two are going to become great friends.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I think so too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. It's really making me look forward to meeting the other two. I can't wait.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If I remember right, they're both guys, right? I can't wait for the chance to talk to them about music! It's going to be great!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You sure are excited, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm looking forward to meeting them as well.
I wonder what they're like.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What's the matter?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Well, I'm looking forward to meeting them and all, but part of me wonders if I ever will.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You don't think you'll get the chance? Why is that?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, it's just...
Haha, never mind!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
O-Oh, MEIKO.
Today's the day I finally want to try a black coffee!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Are you sure you don't want milk and sugar?
You've always used it before.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yep, I don't need it. I'm an adult, after all.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. There's no need to force yourself.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What's that supposed to mean?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm just saying there's no need to push yourself just because you don't want those two we haven't met yet to think you're too childish.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ngh! Th-That's not what I'm doing!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's your choice, of course.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All you've had so far are café au lait with plenty of milk and sugar. Are you sure you're okay going straight to black?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Of course! Up until now, I was just...uh... I was just drinking café au lait because that's what Rin was drinking.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, is that so? I had no idea. Sorry for not noticing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, here's your black coffee.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Th-Thanks, MEIKO. Wow, this smells really...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Bitter...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Len, did you say it smells bitter?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wha?! N-No! I said it smells delicious!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: W-Well, here we go!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Len, you don't seem to be enjoying it much.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's...not true.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Len, you don't have to force yourself to drink it if you don't like it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's right. Besides, it's not as though being able to drink coffee black suddenly makes you an adult.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The amount of milk and sugar I add depends on how I'm feeling.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Some days I'm just in the mood for something different, so I'll have a nice café au lait myself.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Black coffee is reserved for the days I need a little extra kick in the morning.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't realize you switched things up like that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yep. After all, MEIKO takes so much care in brewing it. But I think it's just fine to go with whatever you're in the mood for on any given day.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree with Miku. Besides, when you force yourself to do something, you won't be able to keep it up for very long.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks, Miku, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: All right, I'll take that milk and sugar after all. I don't want to waste the coffee after you went to the trouble of brewing it, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I guess I can wait a little longer before I get used to drinking my coffee black.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It might not be so bad being the kind of grown up who likes drinking café au lait, either.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, I don't see anything wrong with that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. I think that way of thinking suits you, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, this is better. I guess I just prefer café au lait.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Mm... It really does taste better with milk and sugar. I already finished it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: All right, I'm going to go introduce myself to those two.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All right. Be careful.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Have fun.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Will do! Oh, I almost forgot.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: MEIKO, that café au lait was great! Thanks again!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: All right, I'm off!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think Len would be better off just being himself instead of always trying so hard to act like an adult.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure he'll realize the same thing soon enough.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, you're probably right.
